msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. The model must be a completely different woman from anyone in the reference: a new face and a different hairstyle; never reproduce the face or likeness of a real person from the reference. If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia cunadas-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a camel suede western jacket and trousers with fringes and a silk neck scarf from the reference, walking at the Alcazaba of Antequera, Spain, with the Peña de los Enamorados on the horizon, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia cunadas-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy suede jacket with a belt over a floral blouse and cream wide-leg trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia cunadas-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a leopard-print jacket over a white tee and wide light-blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia cunadas-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of a grey wool short jacket and mini skirt set with brown knee boots from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia cunadas-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a metallic grey satin blouse with a black leather skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
